title: Lazar's leak as a planned counterintelligence release
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Lazar's leak as a planned counterintelligence release, about 1988-1989 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So they give it to somebody whose reputation is is really not that good.

related.note: Both explain how Lazar's S-4 story got out as an intelligence move around 1988-89. The story says Lazar was pushed out after Lear gave files to Knapp; this telling says the leak was a planned release through someone with a poor reputation. These are competing core claims about the same event.

plain: UFO researcher Grant Cameron, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, offers a theory about Bob Lazar, a man who says that in 1988 and 1989 he worked on alien craft at a secret site near Area 51, a hidden US Air Force base in Nevada. Cameron suggests the story may have been leaked on purpose by intelligence officials, as a planned move to steer what the public believes, and handed to someone whose reputation was not very good so it could later be dismissed. If so, the truth would have been put out in a form designed not to be believed.
